fields.notes: DisplayPort is an interface specification; it fixes the Main Link electrical/coding (differential NRZ, 8b/10b or 128b/132b, embedded clock, 4 swing + 4 pre-emphasis levels), the AUX channel (Manchester-II ~1 Mbps), the DPCD register space, and the connector pin-out. It does NOT impose PDK-specific SDC/floorplan constraints — PHY characterization (SerDes/CDR, eye, jitter) and board/cable design are Source/Sink-silicon and system concerns. The interoperability-critical constraints are the link rates, lane counts, coding, training, AUX/DPCD, and connector pin-out.

electrical_channel_constraints.fec: Reed-Solomon; mandatory with DSC and for UHBR
electrical_channel_constraints.connector_pins: 4 Main Link pairs + 1 AUX pair + HPD + CONFIG1/2 + DP_PWR (3.3 V) + GND

extraction_hints: Look for floorplan, area, power, timing constraints.
